prompts:
Use case: precise-object-edit / game sprite production. Edit the attached MicroCol selected family 09. Preserve EXACTLY these 40 unit identities in the EXACT SAME reading order, eight columns and five rows. Preserve their selected walking poses, recognizable props, clothes and ships. Convert this contact sheet to a clean TRANSPARENT sprite atlas: remove ALL green/blue squares, ALL paper background, ALL borders and ALL text/IDs. Nothing except the 40 isolated units must remain. Each of the 40 units is centered in its own equal-size cell of an exact 8 by 5 grid with wide transparent gutters, never touching its neighbor. Every complete sprite including separate tools, cargo and cannon debris fits within 80% of its cell width and height. Maintain the same full-body views and identities.
Critical edit: strengthen all near-black warm ink contours significantly, so a sprite reduced to about 38-40 pixels high will retain about a 2 pixel solid dark outline. At this sheet's resolution use about 8 pixels of uniform solid contour width. Remove tiny face and clothing marks, shading, gradients, ground shadows, textures, water and ripples under ships. Use flat solid muted cream, ochre, green, terracotta and blue fill shapes. Keep interior detailing sparse and just as strong; no hairline rigging, replace with simple mast and sail outlines. This is final legible small-map game artwork, NOT a detailed historical illustration. Keep every sprite fully isolated with genuine alpha transparency, including between legs, inside bows, between horse legs and around rigging.
The last sprite is damaged artillery: make its barrel visibly broken, not merely a working cannon beside rubble. The non-mounted soldier in row3 col8 remains unarmed, while equipped musketeers remain the last-row col6 and col7. Keep all 35 base types and five equipment/damage variants, no missing, duplicate or extra sprites. Do not add a title or any writing.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Keep this exact transparent 40-sprite atlas, all 40 subjects, their positions, silhouettes, walking poses, props, strong black contours and 8-column 5-row layout unchanged. Make ONE refinement: remove every interior shadow, highlight, gradient and texture. Every coat, trouser leg, sack, fur bundle, leaf, wooden hull, metal cannon barrel, sail, horse and other region must be a single flat solid color inside the existing dark contour. No bands of lighter/darker color to simulate depth. Keep the strong uniform approximately 8-pixel outline, sparse details and genuine alpha transparency. Remove stray colored fringe pixels outside the outlines. Do not add background, text or labels. Preserve full silhouettes and the visible damaged cannon barrel.
